name: minimal
title: Minimal
description: Quiet captions for film, interviews and editorial video: no box, a thin outline, italic emphasis, heavier key words and faint tints for names and figures.
author: Overtone maintainers
contrast: No box: two thin centered black shadows outline the text, with a soft halo for bright video. Text against the outline is 12.4:1 or more (soft text, 78% white).
